scope: Source-only discovery of Doctor, List Pattern picker, extraction preview, save, and saved rerun. Guest/member/admin remain in the requested acceptance scope.
verification: source-confirmed only; no browser, build, test, database mutation, or credential output in this pass

paths.contract: ShowcaseView force-mounts 12 tabs; DoctorTab executes pageDiagnosticInPage in the active tab, renders recommendations, and recommendation click only calls setSubTab(target). The diagnostic returns a list_pattern config containing list_root and item_selector.

ListPatternTab injects list-picker.content.ts; the picker calls inferListPattern and relativeFieldSelector, emits item-detected then result/exit; background/bootstrap stamps sender tab_id and rebroadcasts; ListPatternTab receives only the stamped session tab.

ListPatternTab calls runMode('list_pattern') via executeScript and offers SaveAsPattern only after nonempty rows. SaveAsPattern inserts wbx_pattern in Supabase; PatternsTab fetches by domain and calls runSavedPattern, which delegates DOM modes to runPattern/executeScript and updates health to ok on any returned array.

findings.symptom: Doctor says a detected repeating group will pre-seed List Pattern, but clicking its recommendation only opens that subtab. Its generated selectors are discarded, leaving the builder at Pick an example item.
findings.cause: The diagnostic result contains recommendation.config; DoctorTab uses only mode and reason, while ListPatternTab has no intake for that config.
findings.reproduction: On a page with at least five repeating cards, open Showcase > Doctor, select its List Pattern recommendation, and observe that the root/item selectors are absent from the List Pattern builder.
findings.first_red_capable_guard: Happy DOM component test: render DoctorTab with a diagnostic result carrying list_pattern config; click recommendation; assert ListPatternTab displays that root/item and can inspect suggested fields. Test must fail on current wiring and pass through the real shared state path.

findings.symptom: A saved list pattern whose root selector stops matching can extract same-tag elements elsewhere on the page, or return zero rows, while the saved run is marked ok.
findings.cause: listPatternMode.runInPage silently changes scope from the missing configured root to document. probeFirstRowInPage repeats the same fallback. PatternsTab and DataView mark every successful array result ok without checking root match.
findings.reproduction: Save a list pattern rooted under #target, then rerun after replacing #target with a new container while leaving unrelated matching cards elsewhere. The runner searches document and returns unrelated rows with ok status.
findings.first_red_capable_guard: Direct runInPage test in Happy DOM using two card containers: configure a missing root and a matching item selector, assert the runner reports a root mismatch rather than rows from the unrelated container. Exercise runPattern/PatternsTab status handling in the integration guard.

findings.symptom: Restart inside the page picker does not clear the partially detected list in the side panel. Cancel after item detection also leaves that config available for field suggestions and extraction.
findings.cause: The item-detected event immediately commits config. Picker restart emits no reset event; exit only clears picking.
findings.reproduction: Pick a list item, press Restart or Cancel on the page overlay, and inspect the side panel header: it retains the prior root/item until another pick or side-panel Restart.
findings.first_red_capable_guard: Component state test drives item-detected followed by restart/exit and asserts the old in-progress config is removed while a previously completed config, if any, is preserved.

gaps_or_inaccuracies: No inventory assertion checks that Doctor recommendation.config reaches the selected extraction tab; C04 only checks navigation.
C28 names a List Pattern picker Clear control, but the list picker overlay exposes Done, Cancel, Restart; Clear belongs to another picker.
No saved-rerun case mutates the DOM so the configured list root disappears while unrelated matching items remain; T36 covers progress/no-match/failure generically.
No case checks Restart/Cancel after item-detected and before Done for stale side-panel config.
Guest/member/admin applicability is retained for acceptance per the user instruction despite inventory's admin-only applicability flags.

test_census.observed_gap: No direct selector-resilience, list-picker event state, Doctor recommendation handoff, or missing-root list-pattern runner test found in tests/ source search.

next_action: With implementation authority, write the missing-root failing guard first, fix the runner and shared saved-run status contract, then wire Doctor config into the List Pattern builder and verify picker lifecycle in localhost from the user seat.
